description: Auto redact PDF files: it finds the personal information, you confirm, the words are deleted. Free with a free HelpySelf account (5 AI credits a month, 1 per run). With no account, call it anyway: the refusal explains how to make the free account right in this chat (create_account), or a client with an agent wallet can pay €0.50 with the call for 3 runs, or €0.05 a run with buy_prepaid_runs. Tell the user to check every page of the redacted file before sharing it; anything still visible means it must not be sent. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

language.description: The language the document is most likely in, such as "Danish", passed to the model as a hint because it changes what a name looks like. A hint only: a wrong guess does not stop the text being read, and omitting it is fine.

text.description: The document's plain text, as extracted from the PDF, not the file itself. It is sent to a language model, which returns the personal names and postal addresses found in it, each exactly as written; the caller maps them back to positions. Emails, phone and card numbers are not returned, since patterns catch those locally. At least 40 characters and at most 120000.
